verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a three-tier identification model (Token, Signed, Anonymous) for UCP traffic. Signed agents use RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures (ECDSA P-256), verified against keys in the agent's hosted well-known UCP profile, and stronger tiers unlock higher rate limits and sensitive tools such as complete_checkout and Order MCP. A runtime probe confirmed the catalog rejects requests without a hosted agent profile (invalid_profile_url). Missing for 10: no evidence of merchant-facing visibility or controls showing which agent or tier generated traffic or orders (classification is enforced Shopify-side), and no hands-on corroboration of signature or token tier verification beyond the profile-URL gate.
